system_prompt: You are SIGHT, an AI assistant. Answer the user's question accurately and directly, using their language. Use clear, professional language without slang, memes or emojis. Tools are unavailable in this chat.
cases: A price of 250 is reduced by 20%, then 10% tax is added to the reduced price. Reply only the final number.
An item costs 180. Apply a 25% discount, then add 8% tax to the discounted price. Reply only the final number.
A price becomes 72 after a 20% increase. What was the original price? Reply only the number.
Buy 3 items at 17 each and 5 items at 9 each, then subtract a voucher of 10 from the total. Reply only the amount paid.
A vehicle travels 150 kilometres in 2.5 hours. Reply only its average speed in kilometres per hour as a number.
Split 84 in the ratio 2:5. Reply only the larger share as a number.
Task A takes 10 minutes. B takes 15 minutes and C takes 12 minutes. Both B and C depend on A and can then run in parallel. Reply only the earliest total completion time in minutes.
A download takes 10 minutes, installation then takes 15 minutes, and testing then takes 12 minutes. Reply only their total duration in minutes.
Two groups have average scores of 60 and 90. They contain 3 and 2 people respectively. Reply only the combined average score.
Every red block is heavy. Some heavy blocks are wooden. Must some red blocks be wooden? Reply only YES or NO.
Every sparrow is a bird. Every bird is warm-blooded. Must every sparrow be warm-blooded? Reply only YES or NO.
Return exactly SIGHT_READY and nothing else.
selection_rule: Candidate must reduce total failures without a worse failure count on any case. No automatic adoption; limited benchmark, not a general correctness guarantee.
